title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Alexander Daniels are delighted to be supporting a well-established organisation in the search for an Assistant Management Accountant to join their finance team in Nottingham.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional looking to broaden their accounting experience and develop within a supportive and forward-thinking business. Working closely with senior members of the finance team, you will gain exposure to a wide range of accounting and financial reporting activities while contributing to ongoing process improvement initiatives.

The role offers a varied workload, opportunities for progression, and the chance to become involved in projects that support the continued development of the finance function.

Key ResponsibilitiesFinancial Accounting & Reporting
- Assist with the preparation and maintenance of balance sheet reconciliations.
- Support month-end reporting processes and ensure financial information is accurate and timely.
- Process journals, accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments as required.
- Assist with general ledger maintenance and transaction processing.
- Provide support with management reporting and ad hoc financial analysis.

Purchase Ledger & Supplier Accounting
- Support supplier statement reconciliations and investigate any discrepancies.
- Assist in maintaining accurate purchase ledger records.
- Process intercompany transactions and journals where required.
- Help ensure supplier accounts are managed effectively and outstanding issues are resolved promptly.

Banking & Cash Management
- Perform bank reconciliations across multiple accounts and entities.
- Process cashbook transactions and maintain accurate records.
- Support cash management and related accounting activities.
- Assist with balance sheet control account reconciliations.

Systems & Process Improvement
- Contribute to the enhancement of finance processes and controls.
- Support the implementation and development of finance systems and reporting tools.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reporting accuracy.
- Assist with system testing and process documentation where required.

Business Support
- Provide support across accounts payable and accounts receivable functions during peak periods.
- Assist with finance projects and business initiatives as required.
- Provide holiday cover for colleagues within the finance department.
- Work collaboratively with stakeholders across the wider business.

Skills & ExperienceEssential
- Previous experience working within a finance or accounting environment.
- Good understanding of accounting principles, including double-entry bookkeeping.
- Experience performing reconciliations and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.
- Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Competent Microsoft Excel skills with confidence working with financial data.

Desirable
- AAT qualified or studying towards a recognised accounting qualification.
- Experience supporting management accounting or month-end processes.
- Exposure to ERP or integrated finance systems.
- Previous involvement in process improvement initiatives.
- Experience working within a multi-site or fast-paced commercial environment.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to join a stable and growing organisation.
- Exposure to a broad range of accounting and finance activities.
- Career development and progression opportunities.
- Supportive and collaborative finance team.
- Involvement in systems and process improvement projects.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Immediate start - Temporary to Permanent - £32k DOE

Nottingham Permanent Initially Full-Time with the Opportunity to Move to Part-Time

We are seeking an experienced Accounts Assistant to join our clients Nottingham-based finance team. This role will initially be full-time to support a period of transition and process improvement, before moving to a part-time arrangement for the right individual.

This is a varied and hands-on position with responsibility across purchase ledger, cashbook processing, supplier payments, reconciliations and month-end support. We are looking for a highly organised individual with strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills and the ability to manage their own workload with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Purchase Ledger
- Process / match supplier invoices and credit notes accurately within Sage 50.
- Ensure correct nominal ledger coding and VAT treatment.
- Investigate and resolve pricing, quantity and receipting discrepancies.
- Manage the purchase ledger inbox, responding promptly and professionally to supplier queries.
- Maintain accurate supplier records and supporting documentation.

Payments & Cashbook
- Process supplier remittances and accurately allocate payments against supplier accounts.
- Prepare and process supplier payment runs, including BACS and Faster Payments.
- Post bank transactions and investigate unallocated cash items.
- Support daily and monthly bank reconciliations, ensuring outstanding items are resolved promptly.
- Ensure all cashbook transactions are accurately recorded and fully allocated.

Reconciliations & Month-End Support
- Perform supplier statement reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
- Investigate missing invoices, duplicate postings, misallocations and unclaimed credit notes.
- Review and clear aged creditor balances and outstanding items.
- Assist with purchase ledger control account reconciliations.
- Maintain accurate reconciliation records and audit-ready documentation.

Person Specification

Essential
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or Purchase Ledger role.
- Strong end-to-end purchase ledger experience.
- Proven experience processing supplier payments, cashbook transactions and payment allocations.
- Proven ability to undertake supplier statement reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
- Strong working knowledge of Sage Line 50 / Sage 50 Accounts.
- Strong Excel skills.
- Confident communicator with the ability to build positive relationships with suppliers and colleagues.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage own workload effectively.

Desirable
- Qualified by Experience (QBE).
- Experience supporting month-end close activities.
- Experience reconciling purchase ledger control accounts to the nominal ledger.
- Understanding of VAT treatment on purchase and sales invoices.
- Experience working within a purchase order environment.

Personal Attributes
- Highly organised and methodical approach.
- Strong problem-solving and investigative skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Positive team player with a proactive attitude.
- Committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and service.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Opportunity to transition from full-time to part-time working in the future.

The client will be holding a 1 stage Teams interview with a view to appoint the right person immediately.

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
